title: GateIntentProposal
description: Body of POST /intents on the gate's data-plane listener (#42): one proposed write. The gate checks intent against the intent schemas, then canonicalizes, hashes and tiers it itself. The body carries no hash or tier.

intent.description: A whole intent ({ kind, args }). The gate validates it against the intent schemas and refuses it with GateProposeRefusal when it does not match.

sources.title: GateProposalSources
sources.description: The context pack and documents the intent was built from.
